The KnightLoader app for Android: a remote control for the instances you run.

## ✨ What it does

- **Connect with the connection phrase.** Type, paste or scan the twelve words your KnightLoader instances share, and every instance in that group appears. No address, no token, no account. A mistyped or swapped word is caught on the phone before anything is dialled.
- **Encrypted end to end through the relay.** The words never leave the phone. The relay receives a key derived from them and forwards messages it cannot read.
- **All instances at a glance.** The overview shows how many are online, a speed graph, and what each instance still has to do.
- **Downloads and Collector for every instance.** Links are grouped into packages that open on a tap. Start and stop the queue or start a single package, drag links and packages into a new order, and remove a package while the files already downloaded stay. The app says when a link filter or a schedule is holding something back, and whether a download runs free or premium.
- **Add links** to any instance, one per line.
- **The KnightLoader look.** Light and dark theme, corners, accent colour, rainbow mode with its colour palette and a choice of how much moves, or the look of your default instance with one switch. Tablets get two columns.
- **42 languages**, following the phone or picked by hand.
- **Problems?** One button copies a report for an issue or an email, with no address and no token in it.

## 📋 Notes

- **Android, as an APK** signed with KnightLoader's own key. The camera is only used for the QR scanner.
